<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>樱花学术汇报模板</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@300;400;500;700;900&family=Source+Han+Sans+SC:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
        /* ===== 全局重置 & 基础 ===== */
        *,
        *::before,
        *::after {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }

        :root {
            --color-background: #FFFFFF;
            --color-text: #333333;
            --color-text-muted: #666666;
            --color-primary: #F5A0B5;
            --color-secondary: #A8D8B9;
            --color-accent: #F5A0B5;
            --color-card: #FCE4EC;
            --color-surface: #FFF5F5;
            --font-body: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Source Han Sans SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif;
            --font-heading: 'Source Han Sans SC', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
        }

        body {
            background: #f0ebe7;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 100vh;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            user-select: none;
        }

        /* ===== 幻灯片容器 ===== */
        .slides-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            width: 1280px;
            height: 720px;
            border-radius: 16px;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #fff;
        }

        .slides-track {
            display: flex;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        /* ===== 单个 Slide ===== */
        .slide {
            position: relative;
            width: 1280px;
            height: 720px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: var(--color-background);
        }

        /* ===== 通用组件 ===== */
        .page-title {
            position: absolute;
            top: 40px;
            left: 60px;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 28px;
            color: var(--color-text);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        .page-title::after {
            content: '';
            display: block;
            width: 40px;
            height: 4px;
            background: var(--color-primary);
            border-radius: 2px;
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        .page-content {
            position: absolute;
            top: 130px;
            left: 60px;
            right: 60px;
            bottom: 60px;
            z-index: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .slide-footer {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 15px;
            left: 60px;
            right: 60px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 5;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
            padding-top: 8px;
        }

        .page-num {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--color-primary);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.35);
        }

        /* ===== 花瓣装饰 (通用) ===== */
        .petal {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50% 0 50% 50%;
            opacity: 0.25;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            background: var(--color-primary);
        }
        .petal-1 {
            width: 40px;
            height: 30px;
            top: 40px;
            right: 80px;
            transform: rotate(25deg);
            opacity: 0.18;
        }
        .petal-2 {
            width: 55px;
            height: 40px;
            bottom: 100px;
            left: 20px;
            transform: rotate(-15deg);
            opacity: 0.12;
            background: var(--color-accent);
        }
        .petal-3 {
            width: 35px;
            height: 25px;
            top: 300px;
            right: 30px;
            transform: rotate(60deg);
            opacity: 0.20;
            background: var(--color-primary);
        }
        .petal-4 {
            width: 48px;
            height: 32px;
            bottom: 50px;
            right: 150px;
            transform: rotate(-40deg);
            opacity: 0.15;
            background: var(--color-accent);
        }
        .petal-5 {
            width: 30px;
            height: 22px;
            top: 180px;
            left: 40px;
            transform: rotate(75deg);
            opacity: 0.18;
            background: var(--color-primary);
        }
        .petal-6 {
            width: 42px;
            height: 28px;
            top: 500px;
            right: 60px;
            transform: rotate(-65deg);
            opacity: 0.10;
            background: var(--color-accent);
        }

        /* ================================================================
                   1. COVER 封面
                   ================================================================ */
        .slide.cover {
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, #FFF5F5 0%, #FFFFFF 70%);
        }

        .cover .cover-bg-sakura {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .cover .cover-bg-sakura svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            opacity: 0.35;
        }

        .cover .cover-content {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 1;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 0 100px;
        }

        .cover .cover-content h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 54px;
            color: var(--color-text);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.15);
        }
        .cover .cover-content h1 .highlight {
            color: var(--color-primary);
        }

        .cover .cover-content .subtitle {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.25);
            padding-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .cover .cover-content .meta {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 24px 48px;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-weight: 400;
            margin-top: 8px;
        }
        .cover .cover-content .meta span {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .cover .cover-content .meta .icon {
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .cover .cover-content .date-badge {
            display: inline-block;
            background: var(--color-primary);
            color: #fff;
            padding: 6px 28px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-top: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.30);
        }

        .cover .slide-footer {
            border-top-color: rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.15);
        }

        /* ================================================================
                   2. TOC 目录
                   ================================================================ */
        .slide.toc {
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 50%, #FFF5F5 0%, #FFFFFF 70%);
        }

        .toc .page-content {
            display: flex;
            gap: 40px;
            align-items: stretch;
        }

        .toc .toc-list {
            flex: 1.2;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 14px;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .toc .toc-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 18px;
            padding: 16px 24px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.70);
            border-radius: 12px;
            border-left: 4px solid var(--color-primary);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            cursor: default;
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
        }
        .toc .toc-item:hover {
            transform: translateX(6px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.18);
            border-left-color: var(--color-secondary);
        }
        .toc .toc-item .num {
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 20px;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            width: 36px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .toc .toc-item .text {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--color-text);
        }
        .toc .toc-item .text small {
            font-weight: 300;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            font-size: 14px;
            margin-left: 12px;
        }

        .toc .toc-deco {
            flex: 0.8;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
        }
        .toc .toc-deco .circle-deco {
            width: 200px;
            height: 200px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.15), rgba(168, 216, 185, 0.10));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 80px;
            opacity: 0.8;
            box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.08);
        }
        .toc .toc-deco .circle-deco span {
            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 12px rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.20));
        }

        /* ================================================================
                   3. SECTION 章节
                   ================================================================ */
        .slide.section {
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, #FCE4EC 0%, #FFFFFF 75%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .section .page-title {
            position: absolute;
            top: 80px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--color-primary);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            background: rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.12);
            padding: 6px 30px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            display: inline-block;
            width: auto;
            border: 1px solid rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.15);
        }
        .section .page-title::after {
            display: none;
        }

        .section .section-title {
            position: absolute;
            top: 180px;
            left: 100px;
            right: 100px;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 52px;
            color: var(--color-text);
            letter-spacing: 4px;
            text-align: center;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .section .subtitle {
            position: absolute;
            top: 270px;
            left: 200px;
            right: 200px;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 22px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            text-align: center;
            z-index: 2;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .section .section-petals {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 320px;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .section .section-petals .petal-s {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50% 0 50% 50%;
            background: var(--color-primary);
            opacity: 0.12;
        }
        .section .section-petals .ps1 {
            width: 70px;
            height: 50px;
            bottom: 20px;
            left: 10%;
            transform: rotate(30deg);
        }
        .section .section-petals .ps2 {
            width: 55px;
            height: 38px;
            bottom: 80px;
            left: 30%;
            transform: rotate(-20deg);
            opacity: 0.08;
            background: var(--color-accent);
        }
        .section .section-petals .ps3 {
            width: 80px;
            height: 55px;
            bottom: 10px;
            right: 20%;
            transform: rotate(50deg);
            opacity: 0.10;
        }
        .section .section-petals .ps4 {
            width: 45px;
            height: 32px;
            bottom: 100px;
            right: 8%;
            transform: rotate(-35deg);
            opacity: 0.15;
            background: var(--color-accent);
        }
        .section .section-petals .ps5 {
            width: 60px;
            height: 42px;
            bottom: 50px;
            left: 55%;
            transform: rotate(10deg);
            opacity: 0.07;
        }
        .section .section-petals .ps6 {
            width: 35px;
            height: 25px;
            bottom: 140px;
            left: 5%;
            transform: rotate(-55deg);
            opacity: 0.12;
        }

        /* ================================================================
                   4. CONTENT 内容
                   ================================================================ */
        .slide.content {
            background: #FFFFFF;
        }

        .content .page-content {
            
            
            
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            min-height: 200px;
            
        }

        .content 

        /* content 内的装饰只通过伪元素呈现，不占用 .page-content 内部空间 */
        .content .content-deco {
            position: absolute;
            top: 100px;
            right: 40px;
            font-size: 40px;
            opacity: 0.10;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* ================================================================
                   5. ENDING 结尾
                   ================================================================ */
        .slide.ending {
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 60%, #FFF5F5 0%, #FFFFFF 80%);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .ending .ending-content {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 2;
            padding: 0 120px;
        }

        .ending .ending-content h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-heading);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: 56px;
            color: var(--color-text);
            letter-spacing: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .ending .ending-content h1 .highlight {
            color: var(--color-primary);
        }

        .ending .ending-content .ending-message {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 300;
            font-size: 24px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            line-height: 1.8;
            max-width: 700px;
            border-top: 2px solid rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.15);
            padding-top: 24px;
            margin-top: 8px;
        }

        .ending .ending-petals {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 200px;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .ending .ending-petals .petal-e {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50% 0 50% 50%;
            background: var(--color-primary);
            opacity: 0.10;
        }
        .ending .ending-petals .pe1 {
            width: 60px;
            height: 42px;
            bottom: 10px;
            left: 15%;
            transform: rotate(40deg);
        }
        .ending .ending-petals .pe2 {
            width: 45px;
            height: 30px;
            bottom: 60px;
            left: 40%;
            transform: rotate(-25deg);
            opacity: 0.07;
            background: var(--color-accent);
        }
        .ending .ending-petals .pe3 {
            width: 70px;
            height: 48px;
            bottom: 5px;
            right: 25%;
            transform: rotate(60deg);
            opacity: 0.12;
        }
        .ending .ending-petals .pe4 {
            width: 38px;
            height: 26px;
            bottom: 80px;
            right: 12%;
            transform: rotate(-45deg);
            opacity: 0.08;
        }

        /* ===== 导航点 ===== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -36px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            z-index: 20;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            outline: none;
        }
        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--color-primary);
            width: 28px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.30);
        }
        .nav-dot:hover {
            background: rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.5);
        }

        /* ===== 箭头 ===== */
        .nav-arrows {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 18px;
            z-index: 15;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .nav-arrow {
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 18px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            cursor: pointer;
            pointer-events: auto;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            border: 1px solid rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.12);
            user-select: none;
        }
        .nav-arrow:hover {
            background: var(--color-primary);
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(245, 160, 181, 0.30);
            border-color: var(--color-primary);
        }
        .nav-arrow:active {
            transform: scale(0.92);
        }

        /* ===== 页码指示器 ===== */
        .page-indicator {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -34px;
            right: 20px;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--color-text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            z-index: 20;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.70);
            padding: 2px 14px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
        }
        .page-indicator .current {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--color-primary);
        }

        /* ===== 滚动条美化 ===== */
        .page-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 4px;
        }
        .page-content::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: transparent;
        }
        .page-content::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--color-primary);
            border-radius: 4px;
            opacity: 0.4;
        }

        /* ===== 响应式缩放 ===== */
        @media (max-width: 1320px) {
            body {
                transform: scale(0.85);
                transform-origin: center center;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 1100px) {
            body {
                transform: scale(0.70);
                transform-origin: center center;
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            body {
                transform: scale(0.55);
                transform-origin: center center;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="slides-wrapper" id="slidesWrapper">
<div class="slides-track" id="slidesTrack">
{{SLIDES_CONTENT}}
</div><!-- /slides-track -->
<!-- 导航点 (JS动态生成) -->
<div class="nav-dots" id="navDots"></div>
<!-- 箭头 -->
<div class="nav-arrows">
<div class="nav-arrow" id="prevBtn" onclick="prevSlide()">◀</div>
<div class="nav-arrow" id="nextBtn" onclick="nextSlide()">▶</div>
</div>
<!-- 页码指示器 -->
<div class="page-indicator"><span class="current" id="currentPage">1</span> / <span id="totalPages">{{TOTAL_PAGES}}</span></div>
</div><!-- /slides-wrapper -->

</body>
</html>
